name: Harlow Creek Medical Center
summary: Our flagship 312-bed hospital with a Level II trauma center, birth center and 24-hour emergency department.
hours:
Emergency: open 24 hours
Main lobby: daily, 6 am to 9 pm
Visitor desk: daily, 8 am to 8 pm
services: Emergency and trauma, Surgery, Birth center, ICU, Imaging, Lab, Pharmacy
parking: Garage A and B; free valet at the main entrance on weekdays
about:
Harlow Creek Medical Center opened in 1974 as a 90-bed community hospital. Today it is a 312-bed regional medical center with a Level II trauma designation, a Level III NICU and a 24-hour emergency department.

The main campus sits along Creekway Boulevard, with clear signage for Emergency, Birth Center and Outpatient Surgery. Free valet is available at the main entrance on weekdays, and Garage A connects to the lobby by covered walkway.

name: Millhaven Urgent Care
summary: Walk-in urgent care for sprains, fever, minor injuries and same-day illness, open evenings and weekends.
hours:
Mon to Fri, 8 am to 8 pm
Sat and Sun, 9 am to 5 pm
services: X-ray, Stitches, Flu and COVID testing, Occupational health
parking: Free lot in front of the building
about: Millhaven Urgent Care treats non-life-threatening illness and injury without an appointment. If you are having chest pain, trouble breathing or a severe injury, go to the Harlow Creek Medical Center emergency department or call 911.

name: Ashford Family Clinic
summary: Primary care for adults and children, with same-week sick visits and online scheduling for established patients.
hours:
Mon to Fri, 7:30 am to 5:30 pm
Sat, 8 am to noon (sick visits)
services: Family medicine, Pediatrics, Annual wellness, Vaccines, Lab draw
about: Ashford Family Clinic is our largest primary care practice. New patients can call for an appointment; established patients can use the patient portal for messaging and prescription refills.

name: Creekway Heart and Vascular Center
summary: Cardiology, cardiac imaging and vascular clinics in a dedicated outpatient building next to the main hospital.
hours: Mon to Fri, 7 am to 6 pm
services: Cardiology, Echo and stress testing, Vascular clinic, Cardiac rehab referral
parking: Shared Garage B with the medical center
about: The Heart and Vascular Center sits next to the main hospital so cardiologists can move quickly between clinic and inpatient care. Cardiac rehab for outpatients is referred from here and delivered on the main campus.

name: Northridge Cancer Pavilion
summary: Medical oncology, infusion, radiation oncology consults and a quiet infusion suite with private chairs.
hours: Mon to Fri, 7 am to 6 pm
services: Medical oncology, Infusion, Radiation consults, Genetic counseling, Supportive care
parking: Dedicated pavilion lot with reserved infusion parking
about: Northridge Cancer Pavilion brings medical oncology and infusion under one roof. Radiation treatments are coordinated with our partner center; consults happen here.

name: Harlow Creek Orthopedic Institute
summary: Orthopedic surgery, sports medicine and outpatient physical therapy.
hours:
Clinic: Mon to Fri, 8 am to 5 pm
Therapy: Mon to Fri, 7 am to 6 pm
services: Joint replacement, Sports medicine, Fracture care, Physical therapy
about: The Orthopedic Institute handles joint replacement, sports injuries and fracture care, with therapy on the same floor as many clinics so follow-up is easy.
